name: Manastorm CoA loot mode: no per-character token cap, the account allowance decides
contract: Requires Manastorm.CoALootMode.Enabled = 1 with the removed option Manastorm.CoALootMode.TokenCap = 5 still present in manastorm-endless.conf, and CoA.BazaarTokens.HourlyCap.Amount = 1250 in coa.conf.

Manastorm Bazaar Tokens (975001) count only toward the account allowance of CoA.BazaarTokens.HourlyCap; Manastorm has no per-character cap of its own, so the leftover TokenCap key limits nothing. A level 60 non-Wildcard leader whose account has earned no tokens clears test segment 1 (Taragaman 11520) for the first time and is paid the full first-clear reward of manastorm_coa_token_rewards (25), plus 0-12 Ethereal Bazaar boss-kill tokens and 50 per bonus cache. With the old per-character cap of 5 the clear could pay at most 5 + 12. The completion message reports the account allowance.

steps.label: CONTROL: the leader entered a private Manastorm instance
Match the native phase 1 Manastorm room so the boss is visible
CONTROL: the leader left the entrance protection at the boss
The full first-clear reward is paid although the old per-character option is 5
The completion message reports the account allowance
